description: Read the TITLE's key-value data store — values shared by ALL players (event state, global counters, server-side thresholds, feature toggles). Returns two scopes: "Static" (authored configuration, written with save_title_data) and "Runtime" (live state that only CloudCode scripts write), each split into "Public" (readable by game clients) and "Private" (server/CloudCode only). Values are always strings. Per-player data is NOT here — it lives in each player's UserCustomData.
name: get_title_data
title: Get title data
